approximation.form: piecewise-linear interpolation of SiLU at 833 uniformly spaced nodes
approximation.lower_gate_clamp: none; gate values in [-16,-10) use table indices 0..191
approximation.evaluation_order: clamp gate; locate i by exact floor on grid; one float32 multiply and one float32 add for interpolation; float32 multiply by clamped up
approximation.fma: not permitted; separate RN32 multiply and RN32 add
approximation.rounding: binary32 round-to-nearest ties-to-even; reject nonfinite/subnormal intermediates

certificate.silu_second_derivative_bound: M <= 1 on [-16,10], proved by interval subdivision in proof artifact
